[Completeness]: You should evaluate whether the assistant's answer is complete with information from the documents.

Begin your evaluation by comparing the assistant's answer against the reference answer in this turn. Be as objective as possible, and provide a detailed justification for your rating. After providing your explanation, you must rate the response on a scale of 1 to 10, strictly following this format: "Rating: [[rating]]", for example: "Rating: [[5]]".

user: IBM Cloud platform
assistant: The IBM Cloud platform is a comprehensive solution that combines platform as a service (PaaS) and infrastructure as a service (IaaS) to provide an integrated experience. It is designed to support both small development teams and large enterprise businesses, with solutions available for working in the public cloud, on-premises, or a combination. The platform is built to support your needs whether it's working only in the public cloud or taking advantage of a multicloud deployment model. It consists of a network of interrelated components that work together to provide a consistent and dependable cloud experience to support your app development needs. These components include a robust console, an identity and access management component, a catalog of hundreds of supported products, and a search and tagging mechanism for filtering and identifying your resources.
user: its applications 
assistant: The IBM Cloud platform supports various types of applications, ranging from traditional monolithic applications to modern cloud-native applications. The platform's open architecture allows you to develop apps once and deploy them anywhere, ensuring workload portability. Whether you need to migrate apps to the cloud, modernize your existing apps by using cloud services, ensure data resiliency against regional failure, or use new paradigms and deployment topologies to innovate and build your cloud-native apps, the IBM Cloud platform is designed to accommodate your use case.


user: About its services
assistant: The IBM Cloud platform offers a wide range of services that cater to different needs. These services include platform services like account management, catalogs, cloud shell, console, global search and tagging, and IAM, which are all globally available and highly available. Each platform service has a Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 99.99% availability. Additionally, IBM Cloud provides infrastructure services, AI and machine learning services, data and analytics services, security services, and many more.All IBM Cloud platform services that support service keys can be integrated by using Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud service binding.
user: Fees ?
assistant: 
For IBM Cloud Satellite, there are no charges for hosts that are attached to a location but not assigned to a resource. You can have as many hosts waiting in your location without being charged for future growth. You are only charged for the underlying infrastructure that you bring to Satellite, which might have its own charges.
For the IBM Cloud push service, there are two components to pricing: a destination instance fee and a consumption price. A pre-production destination instance fee is charged monthly for every pre-production destination added to your Event Notifications instance. Consumption is based on outbound digital messages, with 500 devices or 5000 outbound digital messages permitted per pre-production destination. If either the number of devices or the number of outbound digital messages exceeds the permitted limit, the permitted number is moved by additional 500 devices or by additional 5
[The End of Previous Conversation]

[The Start of Current Turn Question]
Is the data is safe? How do I know?
[The End of Current Turn Question]

[The Start of Reference Answer]
Yes, IBM Cloud takes the need for security seriously and understands the importance of being able to encrypt data to keep it safe. With provider-managed encryption, IBM Cloud File Storage for Classic that is provisioned with either Endurance or Performance options, is secured by default at no additional cost and no impact on performance. The provider-managed encryption-at-rest feature uses industry-standard protocols such as AES-256 encryption, keys managed in-house with KMIP, and is validated for various compliance standards including FIPS, FISMA, HIPAA, PCI, SB 1386, and GDPR. Additionally, all snapshots and replicas of encrypted file storage are also encrypted by default, and all cluster-to-cluster traffic is encrypted with TLS.To ensure that you can securely manage your data when you use IBM Cloud® Security and Compliance Center, it is important to know exactly what data is stored and encrypted, and how you can delete any stored personal data.IBM® Key Protect for IBM Cloud® has data security strategies in place to meet your compliance needs and ensure that your data remains secure and protected in the cloud .IBM® also engages many different firms to assess the security and compliance of our cloud platform.
[The End of Reference Answer]

[The Start of Assistant's Answer]
根据第1页，IBM Cloud 采用分层安全控制，覆盖网络和基础设施，并贯穿计算生命周期，包括构建流程、密钥管理和数据服务安全。IBM Cloud 还提供可供应用开发者使用的安全服务，用于保护移动应用和 Web 应用。此外，IBM 会邀请多家机构评估其云平台的安全性与合规性，并提供相关认证和证明信息。对于 Security and Compliance Center，Key Protect 使用 IBM Cloud 硬件安全模块生成和保护密钥，并通过信封加密保护数据；访问 Key Protect 使用 HTTPS 和 TLS 加密传输。
[The End of Assistant's Answer]

[The Start of Document]
Storing and encrypting data in Security and Compliance Center 

To ensure that you can securely manage your data when you use IBM Cloud® Security and Compliance Center, it is important to know exactly what data is stored and encrypted, and how you can delete any stored personal data.

For more information about how IBM Cloud platform secures your data, see [How do I know that my data is safe?](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/overview?topic=overview-security)



  How is my configuration data obtained?

To learn more about security controls across IBM Cloud, see [How do I know that my data is safe?](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/overview?topic=overview-securitysecurity).



 Data encryption 

Key Protect uses [IBM Cloud hardware security modules (HSMs)](https://ibm.com/cloud/hardware-security-module) to generate provider-managed key material and perform [envelope encryption](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/key-protect?topic=key-protect-envelope-encryption) operations. HSMs are tamper-resistant hardware devices that store and use cryptographic key material without exposing keys outside of a cryptographic boundary.

Access to Key Protect takes place over HTTPS and uses Transport Layer Security (TLS) to encrypt data in transit.

Note that only the following TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 ciphers are supported:



* TLS 1.2:

How do I know that my data is safe? 

Designed with secure engineering practices, the IBM Cloud® platform provides layered security controls across network and infrastructure. IBM Cloud focuses on protection across the entirety of the compute lifecycle, which includes everything from the build process and key management to the security of data services. IBM Cloud also provides a group of security services that can be used by application developers to secure their mobile and web apps. These elements combine to make IBM Cloud a platform with clear choices for secure application development.

In addition to our own diligence in creating and operating a secure cloud, IBM® also engages many different firms to assess the security and compliance of our cloud platform. For more information, see [IBM Cloud compliance programs](https://www.ibm.com/cloud/compliance) for a detailed list of certifications and attestations.
[The End of Document]
